title: Whisker & Bean Cafe
brief: 18 items. Pad the mugs. The espresso machine goes on the bottom. Check every box before you seal it, because Biscuit is in one.
mentor_note: Strap the espresso machine down first. Cats ride wherever they like.

title: The Clock Flat
brief: Mr. Finch is downsizing. 41 clocks, all fragile, all named. Keep them upright and go easy on the speed bumps.
mentor_note: Treat clocks like eggs. Log your rest stops so they get to rest too.

title: Amps and Ferns
brief: New flat. Heavy amps on the bottom, plants on top. The drums are already in pieces, on purpose. Juno will be late.
mentor_note: A plant on top of an amp rides bumpy. Pad it.

title: Flower Shop Merger
brief: Two flower shops are becoming one. Label every box ROSA or RAY, and don't pick a side.
mentor_note: Neutral as a weigh station. That's the job.

title: Pop-Up Coffee Cart
brief: Priya is testing a weekend coffee cart at the park. It's a small load. Biscuit insists on coming.
mentor_note: Short haul, easy money. Watch out for the ducks.

title: Mr. Finch Takes Up Pottery
brief: Mr. Finch found a new hobby. Move his pottery wheel and 30 wobbly bowls to the community studio.
mentor_note: Wobbly bowls, wobbly road. Take the long way.

title: The Laundromats' Practice Space
brief: The band rented a room above a laundromat. You're moving amps up one flight of stairs. Juno brought snacks this time.
mentor_note: Heavy amps go in first. Snacks go in last.

title: One Shop, Two Names
brief: The twins finally agreed on a sign: 'Pemberton & Pemberton.' Move the joint shop to a bigger corner lot.
mentor_note: Look at that. They made up. I logged it.

title: Whisker & Bean Two
brief: Priya is opening a second cafe. Twice the mugs, two cat trees, and Biscuit is hiding in a box again.
mentor_note: Same as the first run. Just more of it.

title: Moving In With Beatrice
brief: Mr. Finch is moving in with his pottery partner, Beatrice. Bring all 41 clocks and her 12 cuckoos. Take your time.
mentor_note: Best load I ever dispatched. Drive it gentle, rookie.
